success_criteria: Zero name_local duplicates across categories within any single day
Day 1 timeline renders with exactly one entry each for 前门大街 and 杨梅竹斜街
HTML generator has cross-category dedup logic keyed on name_local per day
All 9 identified duplicates resolved in data files
constraints: Must preserve the richest data when deduplicating (e.g., shopping entry for 前门大街 has brands data that attractions entry lacks)
Category priority for keeping: attractions > shopping (if has brands) > entertainment
Per-day dedup only -- same POI on different days is valid

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Same places appear multiple times on the page, Day 1 timeline is broken with overlapping blocks
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: DATA issue: Independent subagents (attractions, entertainment, shopping) each included the same POIs without cross-checking each other. COMPOUNDED by CODE issue: the timeline dedup logic at line 2594 uses key = slot + ':' + _type + ':' + name, which means items with different _type values (e.g., 'attraction' vs 'entertainment') are never considered duplicates even if they have the same name and time slot.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - data was generated by subagents, not a specific code commit introduced the duplicates
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Each subagent independently categorizes POIs. Historic streets like 前门大街 and 杨梅竹斜街 could plausibly be attractions (historic interest), entertainment (evening stroll), or shopping (has shops). Without cross-agent dedup, each agent adds what it thinks is relevant.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Items render 2-3 times on the page. Timeline shows overlapping blocks for identical time slots. User correctly notes these streets are attractions, not entertainment or shopping.

dedup_code_fix.current_logic: Key is slot + ':' + _type + ':' + name -- _type in key means cross-category items are never matched
dedup_code_fix.fix: Add second dedup pass after current dedup: key on name_local only (ignoring _type), with priority order: attraction > shopping > entertainment > travel > meal. Keep the first match (highest priority), remove subsequent matches.
